top_bits.scope: All hidden states for the declared traces; no universal coordinate-generation exclusion.

top_bytes.scope: CVP is heuristic. Each dual certificate excludes all 2^48 hidden states for its exact 20-byte trace. No universal coordinate-generation exclusion.

byte_assembly.scope: Direct consecutive top-eight-bit LCG bytes, big/little assembly and reduction modulo 2^521-1. Every certificate excludes all 48-bit states and every admissible reduction quotient. Other output slices, discarded bytes, hashing, scalar multiplication and other generators remain outside this model.
